record.question: India ranked _________ among 119 developing countries on the Global Hunger Index 2017.
record.explanation: Answer B: 100. The original 2017 GHI ranking table, printed page 12/PDF physical page 15, places India jointly 100 th (score 31.4) among 119 assessed countries. Historical/source note: Use the original 2017 rank, not a rank inferred from the present country profile or a retrospective recalculated score. Reference: https://www.globalhungerindex.org/pdf/en/2017.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
